arguments.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS player_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS distinct_player_ids,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE DATE(debut) IS NOT NULL AND DATE(final_game) IS NOT NULL) AS usable_pairs,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE debut = '' AND final_game = '') AS both_blank,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE DATE(debut) IS NULL AND DATE(final_game) IS NOT NULL
                       OR DATE(debut) IS NOT NULL AND DATE(final_game) IS NULL) AS one_unusable,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE DATE(debut) = DATE(final_game)) AS same_day,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE DATE(final_game) < DATE(debut)) AS reversed_dates,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', final_game) > STRFTIME('%Y', debut)
                         AND STRFTIME('%m', final_game) < STRFTIME('%m', debut)) AS negative_month_components,
    SQLITE_VERSION() AS sqlite_version
FROM main.player

arguments.sql:
SELECT CAST(AVG(
    ROUND(ABS(STRFTIME('%Y', final_game) - STRFTIME('%Y', debut)), 2)
  + ROUND(ABS(STRFTIME('%m', final_game) - STRFTIME('%m', debut)) / 12.0, 2)
  + ROUND(ABS(STRFTIME('%d', final_game) - STRFTIME('%d', debut)) / 365.0, 2)
) AS FLOAT) AS average_career_span_years
FROM main.player
LIMIT 1
